findings.case: For a living character, successful ordinary add_inventory_item apple quantity1 establishes a singleton inventory row, stable InventoryObject, measured amount and FoodLot. Public change_inventory_item(character,"apple",-1) chooses measured branch, computes take1 from quantity1, remove_lot_quantity(1,1) deletes food/private lot payload, then deletes amount and inventory row and returns Ok. It never reconciles/deletes the stable object or containment edge. No later fallible operation in that path triggers rollback. The object remains with a Personal location referencing removed backing row. Source-derived valid small reducer sequence, not an executed DB/UI/gameplay claim. Durable removal branch596-608 already invokes delete_carried_object_for_row, which shows the actual shared cleanup boundary.
